answer: A payout is split so that 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The vertex schedule is applied in onyx and quartz shows each instalment. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2991 identities would post 4695 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
